title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Platform)

Senior DevOps Engineer (Platform)
Physitrack PLC · Fully remote, based in Poland Contract: B2B contractor, EUR 8,000 per month
About us
Physitrack PLC builds digital health software used by clinicians, physiotherapists and employers in over 100 countries. Our two product lines, Physitrack (exercise prescription, telehealth and patient engagement) and Champion Health (workplace wellbeing), run on a multi-region AWS platform serving Europe, the UK, North America, Australia and the Middle East.
We are ISO 27001:2022 certified. Healthcare data brings real constraints: data residency, auditability and a low tolerance for downtime. That shapes how we build.
The role
You will own the platform our engineers ship on: the Kubernetes estate, the delivery pipelines and the cloud infrastructure under both product lines. It is a small, senior group with a wide surface area, so you will be making architectural calls rather than picking up tickets someone else has scoped.
A large part of the work is migration and consolidation. Bringing acquired products onto shared infrastructure, moving workloads between providers and regions, and retiring what we no longer need. If you enjoy taking a system someone else built and landing it cleanly on your own platform, this will suit you.
We are recruiting two senior infrastructure roles. This one covers the platform, the delivery pipelines and the migrations. The other, Senior DevOps Engineer (Security and Reliability), covers the edge, observability and cloud security posture. Apply for whichever fits, and tell us if both do.
What you will do

• Run and evolve our multi-region AWS and EKS platform, managed as code in Terraform and deployed through ArgoCD

• Own CI/CD across our repositories, on CircleCI and GitHub Actions, and keep the path from commit to production fast and boring

• Lead infrastructure migrations end to end: containerising applications, moving databases between providers and regions, and cutting over with verification and a rollback plan

• Manage PostgreSQL and RDS at production scale, covering version upgrades, instance sizing and performance work

• Keep our Ruby on Rails runtime current, including framework upgrades, performance tuning and autoscaling behaviour

• Own cloud cost: rightsizing, autoscaling, savings plan utilisation and a monthly cost report to Finance

• Run disaster recovery testing and incident readiness drills, and fix what they expose

• Act as the infrastructure point of contact for engineering, security and commercial colleagues

What we are looking for
Essential

• 5+ years in DevOps, platform or infrastructure engineering, with meaningful time on AWS

• Production Kubernetes, ideally EKS, well beyond having deployed to a cluster

• Strong Terraform and an infrastructure as code instinct

• You have run a real database migration or provider cutover, and can explain how you verified it

• Comfortable with Linux, containers and GitOps

• Solid scripting in Python, Go, Bash or similar, and enough application literacy to debug across the stack

• English at a working professional level. Our engineering team is international

Nice to have

• Ruby on Rails familiarity. Our main application is Rails

• Cost optimisation or FinOps experience at scale

• A regulated industry background: ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA or GDPR

• Infrastructure consolidation following an acquisition

• Polish. The immediate team is Warsaw based, though the company works in English

How we work

• On-call. We run a 24/7 rotation through PagerDuty, with documented playbooks and readiness checklists. Participation is agreed with you rather than assumed, and separately compensated.

• Cadence. Written async updates, a fortnightly planning touchpoint and a regular infrastructure and security sync. You set your own hours and choose your own tools.

• Documentation. Runbooks, decision records and incident write ups are part of the work, not an afterthought.

title: Senior Electrical Integration Systems Engineer, Edge Compute and Communications
description:

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. • Conduct thorough testing and debugging to ensure the reliability, scalability, and resilience of software applications, especially within a distributed systems context

• Work closely with hardware engineers and product managers to ensure seamless integration of software and hardware components

• Collaborate with the team to define and document software engineering processes and practices, ensuring adherence to quality standards and regulatory requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• A passion for systems design, development, integration, and testing

• 8+ years of industry experience including but not limited to electrical engineering, aerospace engineering or systems engineering

• Comfort with systems modeling tools such as Cameo

• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and the ability to operate effectively in an Agile development environment

• Hands-on prototyping, troubleshooting, and build experience of complex robotic systems

• Experience developing automated test scripts and frameworks using a common language (eg, Python, MATLAB, etc)

• Extremely organized and detail-oriented, and excellent verbal & written communication skills

• A sincere commitment to a positive, inclusive, and collaborative culture

• Ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance

• Ability to travel domestically up to 25% as needed for test planning and execution, and excitement to work onsite at our headquarters in Costa Mesa, CA the rest of the time!

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Hands-on experience with prototyping, troubleshooting, and building complex robotic systems

• Familiarity with IP- based networks

• Experience with mission systems to include communications systems and components

• Familiarity with aviation airworthiness considerations

title: QA Integration, Engineer
description:
Master Works is seeking a QA Integration Engineer to ensure the robustness, reliability, and security of enterprise integration flows and middleware components built on the IBM webMethods integration layer. This role develops comprehensive test plans, automates API verification, and executes rigorous scenario-based testing across core operational back-office platforms, third-party web services, and middle-tier microservices.
Key Responsibilities

• Review integration specifications, Swagger/OpenAPI docs, and data mapping sheets to formulate end-to-end testing strategies.

• Validate bidirectional data exchange and state changes between external/internal APIs and underlying operational systems (ERP, enterprise asset management, legacy databases).

• Build and maintain automated API test suites integrated with CI/CD deployment pipelines.

• Conduct payload structure validation, schema validation (JSON/XML), data transformation checks, and transaction rollback verification.

• Execute non-functional integration testing, including rate limiting, API latency benchmarks, error-handling resilience, and token authentication (OAuth, mTLS).

• Track and document integration defects, coordinate root-cause analysis with the webMethods development team, and monitor fixes to closure.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of dedicated software quality assurance experience, with at least 2 years focused specifically on middleware, microservices, and API integration testing.

• Direct working knowledge of testing within Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) or integration middleware ecosystems (IBM webMethods, Software AG, or comparable platforms like MuleSoft/TIBCO).

• High proficiency in API testing tools such as Postman, Newman, SoapUI, ReadyAPI, or JMeter.

• Strong grasp of API authentication protocols, message brokers, HTTP status code semantics, and distributed system architectures.

• Proficiency in writing complex SQL queries to validate database-level state changes after API execution.

• ISTQB Certified Tester (Advanced Level - Technical Test Analyst or Agile Tester), Postman API Fundamentals / Certified Automation, and IBM Certified Associate (webMethods) certifications are preferred.

• Skills in automated testing scripts (Python/JavaScript), CI/CD test automation (Azure DevOps/GitLab), XML/JSON parsing, and mock service virtualization are preferred.

Log Management is where engineers go to make sense of raw data at scale - ingesting, parsing, and querying log data across their entire stack, without the operational overhead of managing it separately. These are the products engineers open when something is on fire, which means the design work is high-stakes and high-visibility.

This is an on-site role in Hyderabad. Many of the engineers and product managers you'll partner with are there too, and being present - in standups, reviews, and the quick conversations before a decision gets made - is part of how you'll build the relationships that make design effective. You'll also work closely with design, product, and engineering partners in the US and Spain, so operating across time zones and communicating well in writing are part of the job, not an afterthought.

What You Bring

- You've owned events, field marketing, community or partnerships in a B2B environment and can show the commercial impact they created - not just attendance numbers.

- You've organised or owned trade fairs, conferences or field-marketing programmes end-to-end.

- You move comfortably between strategy and execution - contributing to decisions on which events are worth Cosuno's time, then sorting the last logistics detail yourself.

- You're a strong communicator and relationship-builder, confident approaching customers, executives, partners and suppliers - and you can prepare and coach speakers.

- You have a strong sense for what makes an event feel well executed, not just organised, and you'd rather build from scratch than follow a playbook.

- You think beyond attendance numbers - relationships, opportunities and pipeline - and work effectively across Marketing, Sales and Customer teams.

- Fluent German and strong English.

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’re looking for someone exceptionally sharp who treats a funnel like a puzzle to solve. Ideal backgrounds include: Growth Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Web Growth, or Growth Product roles, especially at high-growth consumer or prosumer companies where experimentation is a way of life. You could also be one of the first marketers at a startup, or come from an equivalent role like biz ops or growth analytics with experience building from 0 to 1. We care more about how you think and how much you own than about whether you’ve done this exact job before.

Your duties will vary from creating pilots, demos and MvPs, to building relationships with key technical teams to evangelize accelerated computing and Agentic AI. • Prior experience working with technical teams across multiple external stakeholders

• Curiosity to dig into unfamiliar territories to tackle sophisticated problems and be a phenomenal listener.
